pr_title: Support --web flag in issue and pr list
pr_body:
## Summary

closes #1228

I have tested it out from my side

Have also added an `--author` flag in `pr list`, and am making sure that it is allowed only with the `--web` flag
pr_comments: @AliabbasMerchant +1 on accepting a map, or—better yet—a struct
@AliabbasMerchant You may merge trunk now with the latest issue filters 🙇‍♂️
@AliabbasMerchant Thank you for your ongoing hard work! 🎉

issue_context.title: open issue / PR list on the web
issue_context.body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

It would be nice to add:
```
gh issue list -w
gh pr list -w
```
to open the issue / PR list using a browser.
comments: I like this idea! what do you think, @ampinsk ?
I'm into it! Easy and makes sense 👍

review_comments: So now URL generation is shifted to a separate function? Awesome!
Oh. I purposely did not use the `displayURL` function, thinking that it would be better to show the perfect URL, but okay :+1:
The URL-encoded query would be hard to read, so I've made a call to not display it. We also avoid printing query strings in other feedback messages.
